title: Forces and Motion
description: Push a box and predict how its mass changes the motion. The same push speeds up a heavier box less.
learningObjectives: Predict that the same push speeds up a heavier box less

params.description: Mass of the box that gets pushed.

events.name: force_applied
events.description: The child pushed the box with a force.

events.name: motion_predicted
events.description: The child predicted how that mass speeds up.

tutorGuide.intro: Push the box and watch how its mass changes the motion.
steps: Read the mass on the page.
Compare the predicted speed-up with how the box moves.
observationPrompts: What changed when the mass number got bigger?
Did the push get stronger, or did the box get heavier?

misconceptions.belief: A heavier box always moves farther from the same push.
misconceptions.response: The push stays the same. A heavier box speeds up less, so it does not travel as far.

hints: The push stays the same each time.
A larger mass speeds up less.

successCriteria.description: Applied a push to the box
Predicted how the mass changes the motion

accessibility.screenReaderSummary: A box sits on a track. Push applies a force. The readout predicts that a heavier mass speeds up less.
